1. (Currently amended) A cooling system installable within a structure wall, comprising: in a housing, the housing disposed between a pair of studs of the wall, a water reservoir; a pump; a pad; a water distributor; a motor; and a fan, __wherein the cooling system is configured to evaporatively cool air passing through the pad__.

2. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced __approximately sixteen inches on center, with a tolerance of plus or minus one inch__.

3. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced __approximately twenty-four inches on center, with a tolerance of plus or minus one inch__.

4. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the pump brings water from the water reservoir to the water distributor and the water distributor distributes the water to the pad thereby moistening the pad.

5. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 4, wherein the fan causes air to flow through the pad moistened by the water, thereby cooling the air by evaporation.

6. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 5, wherein the fan causes the cooled air to flow through an opening.

7. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 4, wherein at least some of the water flows back to the reservoir for recirculation.

8. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the water reservoir is filled with additional water when the water in the reservoir falls below a predetermined level.

9. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 8, further including a ball float valve that opens to fill the water reservoir with the additional water when the water in the reservoir falls below the predetermined level.

10. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 1, further including a water drain.

11. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing includes a front cover.

12. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing protrudes from the wall less than three inches.

13. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the wall is a load-bearing wall.

14. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the structure is a garage.

15. (Previously presented) A cooling system kit, comprising: the cooling system of claim 1; mounting elements; and a ventilation grill.

16. (Previously presented) The cooling system kit of claim 15, further including instructions.

17. (Currently amended) A cooling system, comprising: __a housing configured for mounting within a structure wall, the housing containing an evaporative cooling apparatus including a water reservoir, a pump, a pad, a water distributor, a motor, and a fan, wherein the evaporative cooling apparatus is configured to evaporatively cool air passing through the pad and direct the cooled air into an indoor area__.

18. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the housing is configured for placement between wall studs spaced __approximately sixteen inches on center, with a tolerance of plus or minus one inch__.

19. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the housing is configured for placement within a structure wall constructed using one of structural insulated panels (SIP) and insulating concrete forms (ICF).

20. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the housing protrudes from the wall less than three inches.
